title: 1919 Prairie's rear roofs: two pinnacled dormers and a flat-topped corner
items: The rear range now has the two small pinnacled dormers all three Gatlin Institute plates show on its street-side slope. Each has one tall light, a stone-coped gable, a finial and a pinnacle at each edge.

The middle range's north-west corner is now the flat-topped block the plates show. Its gable stands 1.6 m back and steeper behind it, so it reaches the plates' highest gable within a few pixels; before, it stood 1–3 m low and to one side.
